exposure: family history of inflammatory bowel disease [IBD]
personal and family history of immune-mediated diseases
cohort: Families with two or more first-degree relatives with inflammatory bowel disease
finding: In families with inflammatory bowel disease, female sex, history of ankylosing spondylitis, exposure to antibiotics, having two or more relatives with inflammatory bowel disease, and having a sibling with inflammatory bowel disease increased the risk of inflammatory bowel disease, while appendectomy reduced the risk of ulcerative colitis.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with inflammatory bowel disease risk in individuals with a family history of the condition.
